source_entries.source: Tabular Puzzles 01 _ Class Notes.pdf, physical p. 4, Q1; brand table
source_entries.question_prompt: Seven colleges J, K, L, M, N, O and P use Dell, Lenovo and HP systems; at least two colleges use each brand. K uses HP; M uses Lenovo; L uses Dell. N uses the same brand as P. Neither O nor N uses Dell. P does not use the same brand as M. Which brand does O use?
source_entries.independent_reasoning: N and P share a non-Dell brand, and P cannot use Lenovo because M does. Thus N and P are HP. With K also HP, and L already Dell, the remaining groups are Dell {L,J}, Lenovo {M,O}, HP {K,N,P}; O uses Lenovo.

source_entries.source: Tabular Puzzles 01 _ Class Notes.pdf, physical p. 7, Q2; course table
source_entries.question_prompt: Nine persons L, M, N, O, P, Q, R, S and T study Marketing, Accounting and Architecture. Each course has two to four students. L studies with N, who studies neither Architecture nor Marketing. M and N study different courses. Q studies with neither L nor M. Marketing has one more student than Architecture. T studies with only one other person. O and S study the same course, but not with L. Q does not study with T. Who among the following studies Marketing?
source_entries.answer: The one who studies with O
source_entries.independent_reasoning: The course-size and clue constraints force course sizes Accounting=4, Marketing=3 and Architecture=2. L,N are Accounting; O,S are Marketing; T and M are Architecture; Q must be Marketing. Thus O’s study partners Q and S are in Marketing, making option D the only true choice among the listed descriptions.

source_entries.source: Tabular Puzzles 02  Class Notes.pdf, physical p. 10, Q3; city/movie table
source_entries.question_prompt: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V watch different movies Pokemon, Ad Astra, Toy Story, Aladdin, Frozen 2, Wonder Women and Rocketman in different cities Nasik, Agra, Bhopal, Rajkot, Jaipur, Pune and Surat. T is in Bhopal; U watches Toy Story; P is neither in Rajkot nor Nasik; T watches Aladdin; either S or V is in Agra; S and U are not in Nasik; P and V watch Pokemon and Ad Astra respectively; Q does not watch Rocketman; the Pune viewer watches neither Pokemon nor Toy Story; S and V are not in Pune; Frozen 2 is watched in Jaipur; neither Q nor S watches Frozen 2. Which pair does not belong?
source_entries.independent_reasoning: There are 12 valid arrangements, but the answer is invariant: V is never in Jaipur. Each of the first four listed pairs occurs in at least one valid arrangement, so only V–Jaipur is always the odd pair.
